description: This file defines the interface ICachePressureMonitor in the Orleans.Streaming.EventHubs namespace, which specifies methods for monitoring cache pressure, including recording pressure contributions, checking if the cache is under pressure, and setting a cache monitor for reporting metrics.

classes.name: ICachePressureMonitor
classes.description: Interface for monitoring cache pressure in the Event Hubs streaming provider, including methods to record pressure, determine pressure status, and set a cache monitor.

methods.name: RecordCachePressureContribution
methods.description: Records a contribution to cache pressure.

methods.name: IsUnderPressure
methods.description: Checks whether the cache is currently under pressure based on the provided timestamp.

methods.name: CacheMonitor
methods.description: Property to set the cache monitor, which reports cache-related metrics.
